body:
The change makes test purpose and maintenance traceable to Design while preserving specialist review authority. Test defines derivation, protective-value, diagnostic and maintenance criteria; Workflow coordinates application; Review and Closeout retains judgment, applicability and completion policy. Product/component Design still owns outcomes and compatibility retirement. Public guidance is selectively packaged for11 quality and8 maintenance consumers without internal Design IDs or repository-maintainer paths.

Design and implementation agree: shared criteria have one policy owner, diagnostic contribution needs material justification, generated/property tests retain an independently grounded invariant and investigable failure basis, and missing authority or flaky/unknown protection is investigated rather than discarded. Existing specialist methods, historical formats and required negative regressions remain intact. Parity validation rejects unknown consumers and missing/drifted copies; existing builders package the added resources. Current v0.5.1 candidate metadata and its pin match generation; historical release metadata, version and CLI/schema behavior are unchanged.

The approved bounded audit inspected8 mirror and10 model methods including partitions. One proposal-only mirror test was consolidated into the strengthened all-resource byte comparison at the same generation boundary. The independent dictionary oracle avoids sharing the builder collector; paths/bytes retain useful diagnostics. Missing/changed/extra output probes with drift checking disabled were detected by the retained test (the missing main file can also trigger an earlier presence assertion). Remaining helper/public, missing/stale and historical/unknown/model-parser cases were retained for distinct protection. All10 model tests remain. No suite-wide uselessness, deletion quota, performance or token-saving claim is made.

Validation: skill373 pass; full adapter158 pass; npm654 total/652 pass/2 pre-existing skips; model/mirror focused baseline8/10, after7/10; post-maintenance full modules7/87 pass. Full-branch PR-mode CI passed all17 selected checks on the exact committed subject; local wrapper4 checks was a separate limited since-M1 observation. TG-01 content scenarios and TG-03 protection assessment are recorded as semantic/manual evidence, not runtime agent simulations. Full record/model/readability/whitespace checks pass; audit-only readability warnings remain. The full check list/provenance is in final-ci; milestone evidence supplies detailed commands and limitations. No hosted CI pass has been observed yet.

Current independent proposal, Design, Delivery, M1, M2 and fresh final whole-change reviews are approved, with no material findings. Both implementation milestones and required corrections are complete. The final review separately assessed all48 engineering subjects and their cross-milestone interactions after implementation; milestone approvals did not substitute. This Verify assessment checks the complete evidence/contract/implementation chain and makes no code-review judgment of its own correction. No correction was authored during Verify.

Evidence reliance: M2 altered only the scoped test file; skill content, builders, package metadata, runtime and environment remained unchanged, so M1 package evidence retains its stated scope. Full-module tests were rerun after maintenance; full PR-mode checks then covered the complete branch. Current subject identities match the final review. Subsequent review/evidence/activity recording is attributable closeout bookkeeping, does not retarget earlier subjects, and introduces no engineering or contradictory proof. The review and evidence summaries do not confer external permission; the user's explicit request authorizes submission of one PR.

Limits and recovery: audit claims cover only the two selected classes. Two pre-existing absent historical Workflow proposal links are not the current proposal, selected owner or proof dependency; their baseline navigation debt is disclosed and not reconstructed. No private/debug files are included. Restoration of lost tests or coherent prior guidance/package recovery is available; current proof and applicable reviews would be required after a correction. No migration, publication, release or customer activation occurs. CLI and record saving remain mechanical. Final lifecycle completion is justified for the delivered scope; PR is the separately authorized external handoff.
